versions.subject: Microsoft Defender Firewall
versions.detection:
selection:
  Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - advfirewall
    - firewall
    - set
    - rule
    - 'group='
    - new
    - 'enable=Yes'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\netsh.exe" CommandLine="*advfirewall*" CommandLine="*firewall*" CommandLine="*set*" CommandLine="*rule*" CommandLine="*group=*" CommandLine="*new*" CommandLine="*enable=Yes*"
